original_publisher: MoneyVis authors: Firat, Vytla, Singh, Jiang, Laramee

preparation.transform: Preserve every row, order, date, type and money string. Replace description for FPI/FPO/PAY/BGC/DEP/CHQ with a type-specific hidden-counterparty label. No sampling, imputation, categorization or synthetic rows.
preparation.currency: GBP assumed from original UK source context; absent from raw schema
preparation.splits: No model fitting. Synthetic domain test fixtures are separate from observed demo data.
preparation.limitations: Masking reduces detail and may merge counterparties for analysis; transfer-like kinds must not become recurrence evidence merely because masked text matches. Raw source remains excluded/local. Not a guarantee of anonymity.

authenticity: Author-described anonymized historical account transactions; no independent authenticity audit
license: Separate dataset license unspecified; article CC BY does not automatically license the data. Local research/analysis; no redistribution claim.
coverage: 2015–2022; single account; not live or population representative
acquisition: python3 scripts/acquire_data.py --verify (cached checksum) or bounded publisher GET; explicit refresh requires new review
privacy: Raw and prepared data excluded from tracking; descriptions masked in 668rows, not an anonymity guarantee; no bank connection
split: No model fitting; synthetic test fixtures distinct from observed rows
